sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Candy Egg Blast lies a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic: matching colored eggs. The goal is to clear as many eggs as possible by creating combinations of three or more eggs of the same color. As you progress through the levels, the eggs will start to rot, and you'll need to act quickly to prevent them from spoiling.

The game features a variety of power-ups and special eggs that will aid you in your quest. These power-ups can be used to clear entire rows or columns, create new combinations, or even freeze eggs in place. With the right combination of power-ups and strategies, you'll be able to clear even the most challenging levels.

One of the standout features of Candy Egg Blast is its increasing difficulty levels. As you progress through the game, the levels will become progressively harder, with more eggs, obstacles, and challenges to overcome. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Candy Egg Blast are simple yet engaging. The game's intuitive controls and increasing difficulty levels make it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
